name: Pinboard
css:
/* Pinboard: a cork board (original photo-style illustration) with sticky-note threads, an index-card prompt, a pinned reply sheet and a paper composer held by washi tape. Pins wobble while the agent works; a red string over the composer runs out as the context fills. Square corners throughout. Light only. */
 :root{--t3-radius-composer: 0;--t3-radius-bubble: 0;--t3-radius-card: 0;--t3-radius-control: 0;--t3-composer-outline: transparent;--pb-ink: #2f2a24;--pb-red: #d43c34;--pb-hand: "Noteworthy","Marker Felt","Chalkboard SE",cursive;--pb-pin: radial-gradient(circle at 38% 34%,#fff8 0 1.5px,transparent 2.5px),radial-gradient(circle,var(--pb-red) 0 5px,#8e1f1a 5.5px 6px,transparent 6.5px);--pb-lines: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0 23px,rgb(90 140 200 / 0.22) 23px 24px)}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]{isolation: isolate;accent-color: var(--pb-red);background: var(--t3-asset-cork) center / cover no-repeat,#b98552}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]::before{content: "";position: fixed;z-index: -1;top: 60px;right: 4px;width: max(140px,min(calc(50vw - 504px),calc((100vh - 70px) / 1.407)));aspect-ratio: 700 / 985;background: var(--t3-asset-pins) center / 100% 100% no-repeat;-webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 12%,#000 92%,transparent),linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 6%,#000 94%,transparent);mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 12%,#000 92%,transparent),linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000
